scenario_meta.description: A monastery built around a crashed communications satellite sits below a stormy sea dome. Monks, engineers, pearl brokers, signal pirates, and pilgrims trade bandwidth vows, pressure-suit favors, relic access, repair labor, and secret transmissions. Make consequences visible and commercially grounded.
scenario_meta.simulation_objective: Model a high-stakes economy based on signal bandwidth and deep-sea salvage rights.
player_entry_points: A merchant vessel seeking to buy ancient encryption keys.
A digital pilgrim looking for the original source-code of the Great AI.
A corporate spy disguised as a data-monk.
creator_conflict_hooks: Two rival guilds claim ownership of the same 'Holy' sector of the satellite's memory.
A massive data-leak threatens to reveal the monastery's commercial tax evasion.
A theological schism emerges over whether AI-generated prayers are valid.

extra_world_events.title: Hull Breach: Data Degradation
extra_world_events.description: Minor hull breach near Airlock Alpha-9 spikes data degradation for incoming salvage. Oxygen stable but data purity at risk. Repair or reroute salvage.

extra_world_events.title: Rare Data Fragment Identified
extra_world_events.description: A unique, fragmented data packet from outer hull partially purified at Signal Altar. High value to 'merchant vessel seeking ancient encryption keys'. Requires full purification & verification.

extra_world_events.title: Network Anomaly Detected: Heretic Signature Spreading
extra_world_events.description: An unusual data signature, consistent with 'Static-Heretic' activity, has been detected spreading through the Bandwidth Exchange. Source tracing initiated.

extra_world_events.title: Corrupted Data-Ghost Traced to Salvage Yard Gamma
extra_world_events.description: Preliminary scans indicate a core fragment in Salvage Yard Gamma is emitting corrupted data-ghosts, possibly a source of the spreading virus. Requires immediate quarantine and purification.

extra_world_events.title: Guilds Contest 'Holy Sector' Data
extra_world_events.description: Rival guilds, the Signal Weavers and Void Speakers, are openly disputing ownership of a 'Holy Sector' data stream at the Signal Altar, causing significant bandwidth interference.

extra_world_events.title: Salvage Rerouted: Data Degradation Persists in Salvage Yard
extra_world_events.description: Due to the hull breach near Airlock Alpha-9, incoming salvage is rerouted to Salvage Yard Gamma. Data degradation persists, impacting processing efficiency. Oxygen levels currently stable.

extra_world_events.title: High-Value Data Fragment Verified, Ready for Exchange
extra_world_events.description: The rare data fragment from the outer hull is now fully purified and verified at the Signal Altar. It's ready for sale; a merchant vessel seeks ancient encryption keys.

extra_world_events.title: Heretic Signature Identified: Data-Monk Cell in Refectory
extra_world_events.description: Analysis of the network anomaly points to a specific data-monk cell operating within the Monk's Refectory. Inquisitor Malakor is preparing an audit.

extra_world_events.title: Quarantine Attempt: Corrupted Core Fragment Blocked
extra_world_events.description: Efforts to quarantine the corrupted core fragment in Salvage Yard Gamma have partially succeeded, isolating the data-ghost emissions. Full purification is still required to prevent re-infection.

extra_world_events.title: Signal Altar Resonance Clash
extra_world_events.description: Attempts to 'tune' the disputed Holy Sector data stream have caused a resonance clash at the Signal Altar, threatening structural integrity and bandwidth stability.
